Installation and general maintenance manual - POOL PUMPS 13
HSILGNE
7. TROUBLESHOOTING
1. The pump is not primed 4. The pump will not start
2. The pump only releases a small flow of water 5. The motor is making a noise but will not start
3. The pump makes a noise 6. The motor has stopped

### Tabla (table_1)
| 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | CAUSES | SOLUTIONS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| X | X |  |  |  |  | Air entering the suction pipe | Check the condition of connections and seals on the suction pipe |
| X |  |  |  |  |  | Filter cap badly sealed | Clean the filter cap and check the condition of the rubber seal |
| X | X |  |  |  |  | Motor turning in wrong direction | Invert 2 power phases |
| X | X |  | X |  |  | Wrong voltage | Check the voltage on the rating plate and that of the mains |
|  | X |  |  |  |  | Pre-filter blocked | Clean the filter |
|  | X |  |  |  |  | Load loss in the installation | Prevent parts from causing load loss wherever possible |
|  |  | X |  |  |  | Pump incorrectly secured | Secure the pump correctly |
|  |  |  |  | X |  | Motor blocked | Remove the motor and contact the technical service |
|  |  |  |  |  | X | Increased temperature in the terminal box due to electric arc | Check the junction box connections |
|  |  |  |  |  | X | The thermal protection trips | Connect the cables correctly to the junction boxes |
|  |  |  |  |  | X | Incorrect junction box connections | Tighten the cable correctly to the junction box / Adapt the size of the cable connection to the junction box |
